selection: One highest conservative-EV selection per event, conservative EV > 0; then probability, proximity to 2, event ID. First snapshot immutable. No maximum odds.
primary: Virtual flat 1-unit ROI, two frozen 14-day observation phases; each requires at least 1000 settled cases, 14 observed UTC days, >=95% eligible-case resolution, no captures after verified actual kickoff, and lower 97.5% three-day-block bootstrap bound >0.
secondary: Brier and Log Loss better than matched no-vig bookmaker probability, upper 97.5% paired Brier block bound <0; ECE <0.08. No model switching or interim promotion.
uncertainty: 10000 deterministic moving 3-day block bootstrap replicates. Repeated players beyond block length can remain dependent.
source: MoviOdds bet365.com.au public observations; outcomes reported, not independently certified; quote observability is not execution proof.
baseline: Matched complete winner pair normalized by inverse-odds sum; EV always uses offered decimal odds, never the normalized baseline price.
scope: New forward cohort for the full model; previous 304-case study and 3000 historical cases remain separate. No automatic bets or validated=true.
batchPolicy: One atomically claimed enrollment attempt per UTC date, at most 100 selections; previous cohort events excluded. Partial batches retained, no same-day refill. Manual updates may settle outcomes but never enlarge a claimed daily batch.
